examples: Give production sessions a red theme so you never mistake them for a scratch one.
how_to: Pick a theme for this session only, or set it as the default for the whole project.

name: Session theme pinning
summary: pin a color theme to one session, or a whole project, so you recognize it at a glance.
where: Open a session, then its session options menu (the three dots at the top right of its terminal widget) and choose session theme.
